tasks.description: When false, Tasks is disabled for this instance.

imipExternalEnabled.description: When false, Calendar does not email new invitations to people outside this instance. Updates to people already invited, cancellation notices, and RSVP replies still send.

imipHourlyLimit.description: Maximum outbound invitation emails per user per hour. Clamped to the daily limit.

imipDailyLimit.description: Maximum outbound invitation emails per user per day. Defaults to 300.
